title: 第2568章 命怎么这么好第2567章 懂你意思
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
铃铃……
下一秒，丘凌风的掌心，灵链生长而出。
在看到丘凌风掌心那墨青色的灵链时，龙傲天脸色一白，嘴角抽了抽，一阵不好的回忆顿时涌上脑海。
他当即脚下一动，准备跑路。
但是千星阁阁主按住他肩膀的手，却把他整个人牢牢的按在原地。
“不要啊！”
龙傲天发出哀嚎。
丘凌风此时已经操控灵链，将龙傲天的身体缠绕住了。
“灵链——压制！”
下一瞬，丘凌风立即动用灵链的能力。
原本还在挣扎哀嚎的龙傲天，就像是被取出电池的玩偶一样，脑袋一垂，整个人都变得无精打采起来，失去了力量。
“灵链——掠夺！”
丘凌风目光一凝，低喝一声。
「叮！」
「已掠夺目标能力，获得神通天赋：通宇」
「神通天赋：通宇」
「描述：沟通不同时空的自我，暂时交换彼此能力。」
紧接着，丘凌风就感觉到自己获得了一股不属于自己的力量。
嗒！
而后，丘凌风依照本能，举起右手，打了一个响指。

在声音响起的瞬间。
丘凌风只觉得眼前的世界开始天花缭乱，无数光景一闪而过。
前后左右，无数时空画面将他包围环绕。
只是，让丘凌风疑惑的是。
这些时空画面里的内容，都被一团黑雾笼罩。
让人看不真切，无法窥见其他时空的内容。
“是因为我本身就在千空镜的影响之下了么？所以这一道神通天赋和千空镜冲突了。”
丘凌风隐约有了答案。
嗒！
又是一声响指，那些将他包围的无数时空光景消散。
“怎么样？”
千星阁阁主摁着龙傲天的肩膀，扭头看着丘凌风询问道。
“这能力对我不管用。”
说着，丘凌风就收回了灵链。
那股本不属于他的力量，也随之消失。
“那太可惜了。”
千星阁阁主叹了一口气，说道。
content_en:
Ring bell…
The next second, a spiritual chain grew out of Qiu Lingfeng's palm.
When he saw the dark blue spiritual chain in Qiu Lingfeng's palm, Long Aotian's face turned pale, the corner of his mouth twitched, and a wave of bad memories suddenly came to his mind.
He immediately moved his feet and prepared to run away.
But the hand of the master of Qianxing Pavilion holding his shoulders firmly held him in place.
"No!"
Long Aotian howled.
Qiu Lingfeng had already controlled the spiritual chain and wrapped Long Aotian's body around him.
"Spiritual chain—suppression!"
The next moment, Qiu Lingfeng immediately used the ability of the spiritual chain.
Long Aotian, who was still struggling and wailing, was like a doll whose battery had been taken out. As soon as his head dropped, his whole person became listless and lost his strength.
"Spiritual chain - plunder!"
Qiu Lingfeng's eyes narrowed and he shouted lowly.
"Ding!"
"The target's ability has been plundered, and the magical talent has been obtained: Tongyu"
"Supernatural Talent: Tongyu"
"Description: Communicate between selves in different time and space, and temporarily exchange abilities with each other."
Immediately afterwards, Qiu Lingfeng felt that he had gained a power that was not his own.
despair!
Then, Qiu Lingfeng followed his instinct, raised his right hand and snapped his fingers.
The moment the sound sounded.
Qiu Lingfeng felt that the world in front of him was becoming dizzying, and countless scenes flashed by.
Countless images of time and space surrounded him from front to back, left and right.
However, what puzzled Qiu Lingfeng was.
The contents of these space-time images are shrouded in a black mist.
It makes people unable to see clearly and cannot glimpse the contents of other time and space.
"Is it because I am under the influence of the Thousand Sky Mirror? So this magical talent conflicts with the Thousand Sky Mirror."
Qiu Lingfeng vaguely had the answer.
despair!
With another snap of his fingers, the countless time and space scenes surrounding him disappeared.
"How's it going?"
The master of Qianxing Pavilion pressed Long Aotian's shoulders, turned to look at Qiu Lingfeng and asked.
"This ability doesn't work on me."
With that said, Qiu Lingfeng took back the spirit chain.
The power that did not belong to him also disappeared.
"That's a shame."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion sighed and said.
